verdict.rationale: Vanta's own API marketing says the API can be used to "bulk assign owners to resources or mark them out of scope, or offload employees in batches" (vanta-docs-23), and the API reference describes it as a way to "automate bulk actions" (vanta-docs-58). This is a first-party claim to the story. However, the endpoints actually shown in the evidence operate on one item at a time: create a control, delete a contract by ID, and upload a contract at 10 requests/minute (vanta-docs-60, vanta-docs-76, vanta-docs-59). That suggests "bulk" may mean scripting many single calls rather than native batch operations. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints or a bulk UI with item-level semantics, evidence that the MCP/AI agent can act on many items at once, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
